fields.name: app_id
fields.help: API Key (APPID) of an Apliiq custom store (https://www.apliiq.com/verified/stores > custom store > API Key).

fields.name: shared_secret
fields.help: The store's Shared_SECRET: signs every request (base64 HMAC-SHA256 over APPID + RTS + STATE + base64(body), empty for GET). Never sent on the wire.

me.note: Apliiq has no account endpoint; the probe lists the last month's orders (an array), so `account` is empty on success. A 401 means the APPID/Shared_SECRET signature was refused.

list_products.note: GET /v1/Product returns the whole blank catalogue as one array [{Id, Name, Code, SKU, Price, Currency_Code, Sizes[{Id, Name, Weight, PlusSize_Fee}], Colors[{Id, Name}], Services, Locations}]; `query`, `category`, `page` and `limit` are not accepted by the endpoint.

get_product.note: One blank product by its numeric Id with Sizes, Colors, Services (screen print, embroidery, digital print ...), Locations (placement areas) and Subscriptions in `raw`.

get_order.note: GET /v1/Order/{OrderId} answers a one-element array [{OrderId, OrderDate, ExpectedDate, TotalQty, SN[shipment notices], StoreOrderId, Status (New, In Production, Ready To Ship, Shipped, Canceled, ...), AwaitingGarment, AwaitingArtwork, CanChangeShipAddress}]. No totals are returned.

track.note: The order's shipment notices SN[{TrackingNumber, Service (e.g. USPS First Class Mail), Carrier (tracking URL), Helptext ("your package shipped on ..."), Items}]; empty until shipped.

not_offered.create_order: POST /v1/Order must be signed over base64(request body) ('base64_encode(HMACSHA256([APPId][RTS][STATE][Base64_ReqContent]...))', https://help.apliiq.com/portal/en/kb/articles/authentication); the runtime's signing templates have {body} but no base64 transform of it, so a POST cannot be signed.
not_offered.quote_shipping: No shipping-rate endpoint is documented in the Apliiq API sections (Orders, Products, Warehouse, Add to store).
